From verse 12, sins that call for death – whoever defies or curses their parents.
23~25절 – 동해보복법 -> 예방법. 시행령이 아니고: Verses 23~25 – the law of retaliation -> a law of prevention. Not an enforcement decree

4~5절 – 원수의 길 잃은 소나 나귀 찾아주라, 미워하는 놈 엎어진 나: Verses 4~5 – if your enemy's ox or donkey goes astray, bring it back to him; if the donkey of someone who hates you has fallen, help it up
No bribes. Show hospitality to the stranger.

In ancient society slaves were disposable. A law that let slaves, servants, and even animals, who could never rest unless someone told them to, rest completely on this day.
